title: Indian Beef Dumplings
description: A flavorful and hearty beef dumpling recipe, inspired by Indian cuisine. Serve with a side of naan or rice for a complete meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, savory spice blend, russian dill, and zealous ginger. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each dough disk. Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Gently add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
